HomePage.title: SCHEDULE EVENTS WITHOUT THE BACK-AND-FORTH
HomePage.description: Create an event, share a link, and let everyone pick their available times. We'll show you when most people can make it.

howItWorks.title: How Does It Work?
howItWorks.description: Scheduling an event takes just a few simple steps.

step1.title: 1. Create Event
step1.description: Fill in the event details, select a date range, and add your participants.

step2.title: 2. Share Link
step2.description: Each participant gets a unique link to mark their availability on a simple calendar.

step3.title: 3. Find the Best Time
step3.description: Our dashboard visualizes the best times. Confirm the event and notify everyone.
